title: 40 years in San Diego: Alaska Airlines kicks off anniversary celebration with 50th nonstop destination
summary: Alaska Airlines is commemorating 40 years in San Diego with a major milestone: the launch of the carrier’s 50th nonstop from San Diego International Airport.
